title: Topviewでキービジュアルを作ってから、Seedance 2.0 miniで30秒の朝ロケ風ムービーに仕上げる
content:
Topviewでキービジュアルを作ってから、Seedance 2.0 miniで30秒の朝ロケ風ムービーに仕上げる  
Topview AIのMotion Studioで、Drama Studioで構築した8枚の人物・背景資料をアップして「見せたい内容」と「スタイル」を指定し、Seedance 2.5モデルで30秒のモーションデザインを生成する  
Seedance 2.5モデルを使い、タイムラインやキーフレームを使わずにタイポグラフィ／カード演出／光と闇の表現を含むAE風映像に仕上げる

en.content:
Create a key visual in Topview, then turn it into a 30-second morning-location-style movie with Seedance 2.0 mini  
In Topview AI’s Motion Studio, upload the 8 character and background reference images built in Drama Studio, specify the “content you want to show” and the “style,” and generate a 30-second motion design with the Seedance 2.5 model  
Using the Seedance 2.5 model, create an AE-style video featuring typography, card-based effects, and expressions of light and darkness, without using timelines or keyframes

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
[PR]
In TOPVIEW AI’s @topviewAIJP “Motion Studio,”
the world of the fictional fantasy “Saint Sasha” was turned into a 30-second motion design.
Upload the 8 character and background reference images built in Drama Studio, and specify the content and style you want to show.
Using the Seedance 2.5 model, it was finished into an AE-style video where typography, cards, and the interplay of light and darkness come together—without using timelines or keyframes.
#TopviewAI #AIVideo
